settings.heading: Make them yours

docMeta.homeDescription: Refined UI components with satisfying hover.

descriptions.surfaces: Five semantic surfaces with purpose-based shadows for light and dark mode.
descriptions.semantic-tokens: Choose color, surface, type, shape, and layer tokens by the object you are designing.
descriptions.scrollbars: A scrollbar that stays out of the way but never disappears, over shadcn's scroll-fade baseline — restyled to the shape system, native scroll on touch.
descriptions.motion: Spring tokens, faster exits, and reflow-free weight animation — the motion rules shared by every component.
descriptions.app-shell: Composable application frame for Sidebar, header, and main content.
descriptions.page-layout: Responsive page composition for headers, content, actions, and optional asides.
descriptions.sidebar: Responsive navigation rail with desktop collapse and a mobile drawer.
descriptions.top-nav: Composable top navigation with brand, primary links, and actions.
descriptions.nav-menu: Router-agnostic navigation primitives shared by Sidebar and TopNav.
descriptions.accordion: Collapsible sections with animated expand/collapse and proximity hover in grouped mode.
descriptions.alert: Composable in-context callout with semantic statuses, optional icon, supporting detail, and action.
descriptions.inline-notice: Quiet inline emphasis that composes with Badge, with an optional semantic emphasized variant.
descriptions.badge: Compact label with categorical colors, custom recipes, semantic statuses, and solid, strong, or dot variants.
descriptions.badge-overflow: Responsive badge list that collapses hidden items into an overflow count.
descriptions.breadcrumb: Composable path navigation with separators, current-page state, and collapsed levels.
descriptions.button: Buttons trigger actions and move people through a task. Choose a variant by priority and intent, not color alone.
descriptions.button-group: Connect related actions into a compact horizontal or vertical control without changing their button semantics.
descriptions.card: shadcn's compositional card, dressed in Zeron Design — stacked, inline, and grid layouts, borderless dividers, and 2-D proximity hover.
descriptions.container: Composable raised container with an optional header and footer around a floating content body.
descriptions.checkbox: Compact checkbox with checked, mixed, disabled, validation, and form states.
descriptions.checkbox-group: Checkbox group with merged backgrounds for contiguous selections.
descriptions.color-picker: Color picker with HEX/RGB/HSL/OKLCH formats, alpha, swatches, and popover trigger.
descriptions.data-grid: Virtualized spreadsheet grid with inline editing, range selection, search, copy and paste, and pinned columns.
descriptions.data-table: TanStack data table with sorting, filters, pagination, selection, visibility, and pinning.
descriptions.detail-list: Framed label-value list with grouped sections and separators for compact resource and entity details.
descriptions.metric-card: Self-sizing single-metric card with optional breakdown, trend visualization, data states, and whole-card interaction.
descriptions.dialog: Modal dialog with smooth enter/exit animations and overlay.
descriptions.dropdown: Menu-style dropdown with proximity hover and animated backgrounds.
descriptions.field: Accessible form composition for labels, descriptions, validation messages, groups, and fieldsets.
descriptions.input: Text input with three variants, five sizes, and accessible validation states.
descriptions.input-copy: Read-only input with copy-to-clipboard button and animated feedback.
descriptions.input-group: Composable input with addons, compact actions, textarea support, and validation.
descriptions.info-item: Composable information row with leading media, primary and supporting text, and a flexible trailing value or detail.
descriptions.kbd: Compact keycaps and shortcut groups for keyboard commands and interaction hints.
descriptions.popover: Collision-aware floating content with a liquid anchor-to-panel transition.
descriptions.radio-group: Composable radio controls with form support and enhanced proximity-hover rows.
descriptions.separator: Accessible horizontal and vertical rules with a semantic border color and layout-safe gutter.
descriptions.select: Animated select menu with bordered/borderless variants and optional icons.
descriptions.slider: Range slider with step snapping, range mode, and animated thumb.
descriptions.sortable-collection: Controlled reorderable list with optional inline editing, removal, and catalog-based adding.
descriptions.stepper: Accessible multi-step navigation with validation, completion states, and keyboard controls.
descriptions.switch: Toggle switch with animated thumb and label.
descriptions.table: Data table with row hover effects and semantic markup.
descriptions.tabs: Pill, segment, and underline tabs with a sliding active indicator.
descriptions.textarea: Multi-line text input with semantic variants, two content sizes, resizing, and field validation support.
descriptions.toast: Animated notification stack with statuses, automatic dismissal, actions, and drag gestures.
descriptions.tooltip: Floating tooltip with spring-based animations and configurable placement.
descriptions.ask-user-questions: Stepped question flow with single/multi-select, optional 'other' input, and skip.
descriptions.chat-message: Chat transcript bubble with baked-in motion, user/assistant alignment, and file attachments.
descriptions.input-message: Chat-style message composer with auto-resizing textarea and configurable action slots.
descriptions.thinking-indicator: Animated status indicator with morphing SVG and cycling text.
descriptions.thinking-steps: Chain-of-thought display with sequential animation and collapsible steps.
descriptions.overview: The provider, public API, and style model behind Zeron Design icons.
descriptions.usage: Use named icon slots without coupling application code to a source icon library.
descriptions.catalog: Searchable names generated from the free icon provider's actual exports.
descriptions.providers: Free and licensed icon styles, plus the boundary for optional Pro packages.
descriptions.provider-create-form-01: A three-step provider setup workflow with credential verification, model discovery, per-model availability, and final review.
descriptions.agent-trace-01: A turn-aware agent execution trace with local JSON upload and raw-record inspection.
descriptions.agent-session-detail-01: A session detail workspace with agent navigation, session switching, and an embedded execution trace.
descriptions.resource-catalog-01: A responsive model and MCP marketplace with search, sorting, page-local filters, and resource cards.
descriptions.mcp-detail-01: An MCP resource detail page with safe connection generation and a minimal tool test panel.
descriptions.model-detail-01: A model detail page with API-key handoff, code samples, benchmark data, and endpoint information.
descriptions.resource-details-01: A grouped resource metadata panel with health, configuration, usage, and API compatibility details.
descriptions.resource-list-table-01: A searchable, selectable resource inventory with status filtering and reusable row actions.
descriptions.cluster-environment-detail-01: A cluster environment health report that composes overview, metrics, incidents, and inspection detail into one workspace.
descriptions.resource-metric-list-01: A compact resource inventory with status distribution bars for infrastructure health at a glance.
descriptions.resource-status-all-01: A resource-status summary with a circular distribution, detailed counts, and determinate-state coverage.
descriptions.top-nav-app-shell-01: A stacked application shell with a centered TopNav and focused content area.
descriptions.zaiops-operations-01: An operations workspace recipe with a responsive Sidebar, organization switcher, and grouped navigation.
descriptions.zlrlist: A ZS Live Recovery protection-group workspace with responsive navigation, Figma-aligned list and detail views.
